notes.title: Version 1.3.5 now live
notes.content:
Added a new skin
    Fixed a bug that makes the game crash on start up.
    Fixed a bug that makes it impossible to load hard difficulty levels when using Keyboard controls.


For those who own the game if you encounter a bug let me know by posting in the Forums

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 Released
notes.content:
Update 1.1.0 have been rolled out.  Below is a list of what was added.


PS4 and other Generic controllers can be used with the Steam Controller Configuration.
PS4 Controller prompts.
Locked game modes now show how many stars are needed to be unlocked.
Custom puzzles can now be played in the Cross gameplay mode.

notes.title: Release Issue
notes.content:

Edit: 
I think I will have to attempt release on Monday 7/24 due to this issue since I can't release today

It seems I can release tomorrow (Hopefully) If not I will post letting you know what happens.  Valve made a change on thier end that affected my release date so that is what's going on.
